card.name: Ending of inducers and substrates
card.fires_on: The final piece of 'inducers' (or 'substrates') after 'indu' or 'substr', right after a CYP enzyme name in drug interaction text.

modes.label: inducers
modes.description: The ending of 'inducers' after 'indu', usually following CYP3A4 or CYP3A.
modes.example: The concomitant use of ADDYI with CYP3A4 indu<<cers>> substantially decreases flibanserin exposure compared

modes.label: substrates
modes.description: The ending of 'substrates' after 'substr' following a CYP enzyme name.
modes.example: KAT XR is an inhibitor of CYP1A2. Concomitant use of VYKAT XR with CYP1A2 substr<<ates>> increases exposure of these substrates.
